notes.title: Watch the live broadcast of our latest game The Holy Gosh Darn!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Head over to the Holy Gosh Darn store page to watch our live broadcast as well as being able to play the demo for the duration of Steam Nest Fest! [/b][/h3]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1466230/The_Holy_Gosh_Darn]Store Page![/url]

We are back with the third instalment of the Tuesday trilogy The Holy Gosh Darn launching early next year! The Holy Gosh Darn has far less limb based puzzles, in fact it may have no limb based puzzles! But don't let that stop you, if you enjoyed Helheim Hassle... Which honestly we hope you did because you are reading this, we are sure you will love The Holy Gosh Darn! With all the humour and puzzle elements you expect from the Tuesday Trilogy... Except the limbs, well there are limbs but they don't detach. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36700119/2f822f62bb96aeedbdeb4040e3dbe6a6957903b2.png[/img]

[h3]The Holy Gosh Darn[/h3]
Rewind time and save the future in this hilarious time-travelling adventure game.
In six hours, Heaven will be destroyed. Unless you can save it. Use your powers of time
travel to jump freely between the past and present across Heaven, Hell, Earth and Helheim.
Uncover information in one timeline to alter things in another in a bid to stop heaven
from going bang. Again.

If you can't make the live broadcast or you loved watching this comedic time traveling adventure and can't wait for more! Head to our store page where you can play the demo as part of Steam Next Fest until Monday! 

We really hope you enjoy the demo and would consider wishlisting the game and joining the community on discord [url=https://discord.gg/zxWunsYkyv]HERE! [/url]

notes.title: Helheim Hassle Holiday Hustle
notes.content:
Continuing in the vein of 'let's just keep pretending everything is normal' we would like to wish everyone a happy holiday with some amazing seasonal in-game visual changes and items! 

Will there be a holiday sale as well? Probably, but why wait to buy the game when you can get it now? We here at Perfectly Paranormal firmly believe we should all lean into the age of instant gratification. For profit. For love.

To enable the new visuals we have added a temporary launch option when starting the game through steam, this let's you choose if you want to play the holiday themed version, or the classic one.

You may have to restart your steam client for this launch option to become available.

We hope you all have a lovely holiday and thank you for playing!

Discord: https://discord.gg/7pfUKae

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1
notes.content:
Hello and a happy October to ya'll! We wish we had this message localized to Spanish, buuuut that didn't happen... instead we localized the whole game to Spanish!
And we also made a few other fixes! Enjoy!

Patch notes: (SPOILER)
- Added Spanish localization.
- Fixed issue where you could get stuck in the turret puzzle in Polyester Valley.
- Fixed issue where the Moose would not be visible in some cases.

As always, if you want to get in touch and tell us all about your life and whatnot, discord is the place to be! (https://discord.gg/7pfUKae)

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
(SPOILER)

We're 3 for 3 on patches so far this week. After a long and dangerous investigation into the disappearing Robot head conundrum, I believe we have finally found the cause of the issue.

Patch notes:
- Fixed issue regarding traveling to another county with Modgunn attached. The game would deactivate her as you traveled, but not register that she was detatched, causing things to get weird in a hurry.
- Fixed issue when traveling to another county while controlling another bodypart than the torso, while the torso had either Modgunn or the Robot head attached. This would cause the heads not to be detatched properly, causing weird stuff.
- Fixed issue when traveling to another county with Modgunn attached, causing her to be rotated wrong when taking her out the next time, which could cause weird stuff.
- Fixed a puzzle in Shackstead that registered as complete twice, causing the map to display the wrong number of complete puzzles.
- Fixed a crash that ocurred when being attached to a furniture in Huldras cave, with the rest of your body in another area, then traveling with the attached bodypart to another area, saving/reloading and then changing focus.

Hopefully this takes care of all future Robot head issues, at least we're heading... in the right direction. I should leave? I understand.

Discord: https://discord.gg/7pfUKae

Have a great wednesday!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.9
notes.content:
Happy tuesday everyone!

(SPOILER)

This patch addresses some issues regarding saving/loading in Polyester Valley and Huldras Cave.

We have some reports of the Robot head  going missing from Polyester Valley, unfortunately this has only occurred on console versions as far as we know so we do not have access to the save files.
This patch addresses some issues we found related to this, as well as some potential issues. 

[b]However, if you're playing on Steam and you have had this issue, we would love it if you could get in touch and send us your save files![/b]

Patch notes:
- Fixed issue in Polyester Valley where player could skip the puzzle right before getting the Robot head.
- Fixed crash when attaching a bodypart to a furniture in Huldras cave, then traveling to another area with the rest of your body, then saving and reloading.
- Fixed issue where if the player left bodyparts in multiple areas, then saved and reloaded, the wrong area would sometimes be focused.
- Fixed potential crash when loading a game and an avatar does not have a valid area to spawn.
- Fixed potential issue where Robot head in Polyester Valley could be saved to the wrong area, causing it to not spawn when reloading. This may be the reason why players have experienced the Robot head disappearing. 
- Added an 'allowed area' for the Robot head to spawn in when loading a game, if it is somehow outside of this area then it's position is reset.

If you find any more proof of my incompetence, the best place to rub it in my face is Discord ( https://discord.gg/7pfUKae ).

Thanks!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.8
notes.content:
Hello!
Once again some of you have been busy breaking our carefully crafted house of cards that is the Helheim Hassle code, so here is a few new fixes in what we have lovingly named patch 1.0.8. 

Patch notes: (SPOILER)
- Fixed issue where if you quit the game while loading from Nivlheim to Helheim and then reloaded, Bjørn would keep falling in an endless void.
- Fixed issue where if you quit the game while watching the first Valhalla cutscene, or the first Hell cutscene, the save slot 'rocks' in the main menu would display 'missing translation'.
- Made the game force a save when changing worlds to prevent possible data loss due to something blocking normal saving.

As always, if you're experiencing any issues the best place to reach us is on Discord: ( https://discord.gg/7pfUKae )

And as always 2: If you've played played the game and enjoyed it, please consider leaving a positive review!

Thank you!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.content:
IMPORTANT: If you have completed the main story on one save and then quit to menu and started a new save, that save may be broken.
There was an issue with version 1.0.2 where the 'mainStoryFinished' flag would not reset if playing on a save that had finished the main story -> quitting to menu -> creating a new save.
This issue led to the Good Bjørn achievement being unlocked when it wasn't supposed to. 
Another problem with this is that it will completely break your save when reaching Helheim, and potentially break it when reaching Shackstead.
To check if this issue affects you, you can look at your save slot menu:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36700119/dcdae917260de946bbaa98512f79f9d47e9a96e7.png[/img]
If you haven't completed the main story, but the icon in the picture is glowing, you have this issue. 
This patch will check your save files and fix it if you have not reached Shackstead yet. If you have reached Shackstead however, we are really sorry to inform you that your save files are broken and you should start a new game if you want to keep playing.

Patch notes:
- Added a check to fix your save data if the mainStoryFinished flag is set when it wasn't supposed to, and you havent reached Shackstead yet.
- Fixed an issue where players could fast travel away from Polyester Valley before unlocking any fast travel points, making this area forever inaccessible.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
Patch notes 1.0.4

Happy monday everyone, thankfully it's not tuesday yet!
Here are a few new fixes!

As always, if you experience any issues the best place to contact us is through discord: ( https://discord.gg/7pfUKae )

Additionally we will be releasing the Helheim Hassle Soundtrack in about 30 minutes from me writing this! 

Patch notes: (SPOILERS)

- Fixed issue where leaving Modgunn attached to her door in Shackstead, and then traveling to another level, saving and quitting would cause the game to crash when loading.
- Fixed issue where reattaching Modgunn to her door in Shackstead would cause the game to save when it wasn't supposed to.
- Fixed issue where leaving Modgunn in one area and then traveling to another area in the same world, then saving and reloading, would cause her to spawn and fall infinetly until the player put her back in their inventory or traveled to another world.
- Fixed issue where time since last save would always show as 'less than one minute' because I'm... quite frankly, not a very good programmer.
- Added two additional checkpoints to a certain chase sequence in Wetwood.
- Fixed a draw order issue in New Goblin Woods
- Added a door in Shackstead to prevent players from skipping huge parts of the level.
- Fixed issue where 'These Runes Are Made Up' quest could be started again after completing it.

notes.title: Patch notes 1.0.3
notes.content:
Hello!
It's time for the very first post-launch patch. There have been a few reported issues since release that we wanted to address as soon as possible. 
If you're having issues the best way to report them is via our discord channel ( https://discord.gg/7pfUKae ), if you're not comfortable with that then you can get in touch via e-mail instead. We try to address issues as fast as we can!

We appreciate all the great feedback we have been getting, thank you all for playing!

Patch notes 1.0.3

- Fixed issue where if you united an arm with the torso or a leg while climbing a corner, the arm would no longer be able to be crushed by moving platforms.
- Fixed issue where bodyparts would not 'disconnect' from moving platforms when dying, resulting in the bodypart being offset by however much the platform had moved when respawning.
- Fixed issue where you could potentially enter the horn room before you were supposed to.
- Disabled autosave every 10 minutes to prevent people from potentially getting stuck somewhere and then the game saves. The game saves often enough between events that this should not cause any huge issues.
- Fixed issue where players could fast travel from a active puzzlecon puzzle, causing the puzzle not to be exited properly.
- Fixed issue where throwing Modgunn into an inaccessible area would trigger a 'run away' sequence, which would soft-lock the game because Modgunn cannot move.
- Fixed an exploit where players could repeatedly autothrow->unite->autothrow in order to scale walls.
- Fixed issue where Good Bjørn achievement would unlock when it wasn't supposed to.

Have a great weekend everyone!
